name: Quiz Application
description: Take short random multiple-choice quizzes, review the answers, and keep a history of saved attempts
backend_requirements: Access control: anyone may draw a quiz and submit answers; require auth for adding questions and for the attempt history (an attempt is saved only for a signed-in user, who alone can read it); admin endpoints are restricted to the admin account
Questions have a text, four options (option_a to option_d) and a correct_option (one of A, B, C, D); on first start with no questions, seed at least 20 general-knowledge questions (ids from 1)
Question validation: text is a required non-empty string of at most 500 characters; each option is a required non-empty string of at most 200 characters; correct_option must be A, B, C or D
GET /api/quiz returns ?count= random active questions (default 5, from 1 to 10; fewer when fewer exist), without their correct_option; total is the number of questions returned

POST /api/attempts scores a list of answers, each a question_id and the selected option (A to D): every question_id must be an active question and appear at most once, and at least one answer is required; score is the percentage of correct answers rounded to a whole number

The attempt response always lists every answered question with its text, options, the selected option, the correct_option and is_correct; for a signed-in user the attempt is saved and its id returned, for a visitor id is null and nothing is stored
GET /api/attempts lists the signed-in user's saved attempts, newest first; GET /api/attempts/:id returns one of them with the same results as the submit response
Deactivated questions (is_active false) are never drawn and cannot be answered in new attempts; saved attempts keep showing them; the admin overview still lists them
Errors answer with a JSON object {"detail": "<message>"}: 400 for invalid input, 401 without a valid token, 403 for a non-admin on admin endpoints, 404 for unknown ids
frontend_requirements: Everyone can take quizzes; signed-in users also get the attempt history and the 'Add question' form, and visitors see a 'Sign in to save your results' prompt on the result screen
Sign-in and registration forms that call /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register; keep the token for later requests, show the signed-in username and offer sign-out
Quiz view: one question at a time with its four options as radio buttons, a progress indicator ('Question 2 of 5'), 'Next' to move on and 'Submit' on the last question
Result view: the score as a percentage and the number correct, then every question with the chosen and the correct option marked, and a 'Start new quiz' button
History view: the user's saved attempts (date, score, number of questions); opening one shows its review
Add question form (text, four options, the correct option) that shows the API's validation messages
admin_requirements: Admin overview: every question, active or not, newest first, with its correct option and total, active and inactive counts
Toggle a question's active status from the overview

data_models.name: Question
data_models.description: A multiple-choice question with four options; seeded on first start

fields.correct_option: string (one of: A, B, C, D; left out of quiz draws)
fields.user_id: integer (optional; references the signed-in user who added it, null for seeded questions)
fields.is_active: boolean (default true; false keeps the question out of new quizzes)

data_models.name: Attempt
data_models.description: A signed-in user's scored quiz submission

fields.user_id: integer (references the signed-in user who submitted it)

data_models.name: AttemptAnswer
data_models.description: One answered question within an attempt

fields.attempt_id: integer (references Attempt.id; deleted with the attempt)
fields.selected: string (one of: A, B, C, D)
